name: Aster Staked USDF
oneLiner: asUSDF is the staked, NAV-accreting wrapper of Aster's USDF, capturing yield from underlying delta-neutral and funding-fee strategies on Binance/MirrorX.
collateral: USDF deposited into the Aster Earn asToken wrapper; upstream USDF is backed by USDT held through Ceffu and delta-neutral Binance / MirrorX strategies.
pegMechanism: Users stake USDF to mint asUSDF. asUSDF APY is reflected in NAV from delta-neutral and funding-fee strategies; withdrawals return USDF after Aster's documented T+1 hour / two-hour waiting period with no mint or withdrawal fee.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: asUSDF resolves to Upstream because it is a staked wrapper of USDF and inherits the parent asset's custody, reserve, and issuer-control exposure. The holder-facing asUSDF contract is role-controlled and pausable, with mint/burn authority assigned to privileged roles.

mintAuthority.summary: asUSDF is the savings-passthrough staked wrapper of Aster USDF; shares are minted when USDF is staked and do not create base USDF supply, so its mint authority is inherited from USDF (usdf-astherus).

controls.label: Aster Earn asUSDF wrapper token
controls.capDescription: asUSDF shares are minted/burned by the Aster Earn wrapper against staked USDF deposits and withdrawals; this share accounting cannot create or destroy base USDF supply.
controls.evidence: Savings-passthrough wrapper: staking USDF mints asUSDF shares whose NAV accrues from underlying strategy yield; minting shares only follows USDF deposits and does not expand the parent USDF supply.

controls.label: Inherited USDF (Astherus) MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE mint path
controls.evidence: Underlying USDF supply is created via an AccessControl MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE with an owner/default-admin path (permissioned-minter, partially-bounded-admin); this wrapper holds USDF and inherits that base mint authority.

review.evidence: asUSDF (variantOf usdf-astherus, variantKind savings-passthrough) is a staked wrapper whose shares track deposited USDF; base mint authority is the inherited USDF permissioned-minter path (partially-bounded-admin) and is mirrored here.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Wrapper classification follows from coin metadata (variantOf usdf-astherus, savings-passthrough, wrapper reserve); posture mirrors the USDF parent mint authority.
